title: PennantPark Expands Access to Private Wealth Investors Through iCapital® Marketplace
summary: PennantPark announced that its private credit strategy is now available on iCapital Marketplace, giving financial advisors and their high-net-worth clients streamlined access to its institutional-quality strategy.
body_markdown:
MIAMI, August 26, 2026 — PennantPark, a leading independent private credit platform focused on the core middle market, today announced that its private credit strategy is now available on iCapital Marketplace, giving financial advisors and their high-net-worth clients streamlined access to its institutional-quality strategy.


The integration continues PennantPark’s expansion into private wealth, pairing the firm’s disciplined, income-focused lending strategy with iCapital’s technology infrastructure to make subscription, reporting, and portfolio construction more efficient for advisors already using the platform.


“Advisors shouldn’t have to choose between a differentiated strategy and a seamless process for accessing it,” said Art Penn, Founder of PennantPark. “iCapital Marketplace gives us the scale and infrastructure to put our core middle market strategy directly into advisors’ existing workflow, rather than
asking them to work around it.”


The move comes as more advisors look to build out alternatives allocations without adding operational burden and reflects the growing role that platforms like iCapital play in making private markets a standard part of the wealth management stack. PennantPark’s 19-year track record navigating multiple credit cycles supports that shift toward specialized, income-oriented strategies delivered at scale.


As PennantPark continues to build out its private wealth footprint, availability on iCapital Marketplace underscores the firm’s focus on making core middle market credit both accessible and operationally simple for advisors and their clients.
